annotations.title: Get a live price for a stay

description: Returns a live quote for one unit and stay. When the stay can be booked: nights, currency, nightlyRate, cleaningFee, totalPrice (nights plus cleaning fee; taxes and any other fees added at checkout are not included, and taxesIncluded says so), cancellationPolicy, bookingUrl (the site's page for that unit with the dates and guests filled in), and eventsDuringStay (up to 5 events on during the stay, with the total count). When it cannot be booked: available false with a reason (unavailable, closed_arrival, closed_departure, min_stay, max_stay, too_many_guests, invalid_dates) and a message saying what to change.

propertyId.description: The propertyId of a unit on that site, as returned by list_properties.

siteSlug.description: The siteSlug of a Booking Bench site, as returned by list_sites.
